title: Jr NTR's Birthday Brings First Look at NTRNEEL
excerpt: The Telugu superstar and KGF director Prashanth Neel drop the first glimpse of their mega-collab on May 20, with a June 2027 release locked.
body:
Jr NTR and director Prashanth Neel lit up the internet on April 21 when the production officially confirmed that the first glimpse of their much-anticipated collaboration, #NTRNeel, drops on May 20 — the actor's 43rd birthday. The high-profile project has locked a global theatrical release date of June 11, 2027, with its first official glimpse scheduled to drop on May 20, 2026.

**What the announcement revealed:**
The makers unveiled a striking new poster confirming the May 20 glimpse date, aligning it with Jr NTR's birthday. The poster showcases the actor in a powerful and stylish new avatar, significantly amplifying excitement among fans and industry circles alike. The glimpse carries the evocative title 'When the storm finds its purpose..' The film, tentatively titled Dragon and currently referred to as NTRNeel, will now hit theatres worldwide on June 11, 2027, instead of its initially expected June 2026 release window.

**Why this collaboration commands attention:**
Helmed by Prashanth Neel, known for delivering massive hits like KGF and Salaar, this project is being described as his most ambitious venture yet, with expectations naturally sky-high given his track record of crafting large-scale, high-impact narratives. Produced under the banners of Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts, #NTRNeel has been generating tremendous buzz since its announcement. Besides Jr NTR, the movie also stars Rukmini Vasanth, Biju Menon, and Anil Kapoor. Reports also suggest Shahid Kapoor may be in talks for the main antagonist role after scheduling conflicts ruled out Tovino Thomas.

**What to watch next:**
With the first glimpse arriving on May 20, the film is clearly entering an important promotional phase — if the teaser lands well, it could set the tone early and push expectations even higher for what is already being seen as a major 2027 release.
